before_board.S: Induced subgraph H of the hypercube Q_n with 2^{n-1}+1 vertices (the Gotsman-Linial 1992 reduction).

bound_then: Delta >= (1/2 - o(1)) log n (Chung-Fueredi-Graham-Seymour 1988); sqrt(n) conjectured.
leak: Counting controls the mean degree, not the maximum. The unsigned spectrum of Q_n is n-2k, additive under Cartesian product, so the median eigenvalue is about 0 and interlacing is empty.
